FINAL_CHOICE: At 6:42 AM the holder was `main_0525_M` (the main run at 172.0 M steps of phase two, shipped at 5:37 AM). On three engine seeds on the two generated suites and five on the two authored ones, the weighted headline of `blend_final_M` is 79.61 ± 1.07 against 78.91 ± 1.06, a paired difference of +0.70 ± 0.74 with a noise margin of 1.49: level, so by the rule alone the holder would have stayed. No suite is worse by more than noise; better by more than noise: `heldout_v1` (+1.69 ± 0.75). On the organizer-style suite, which is not part of the rule, it scores 74.98 against 68.35: +6.64 ± 1.30, better by more than noise (normal half 88.17 against 84.42, +3.75 ± 1.26, better by more than noise; dense half 61.80 against 52.27, +9.52 ± 2.25, better by more than noise). The team lead decided to ship `blend_final_M`: it is not worse by more than noise on any suite and it is clearly better on the maps most like the organizers' own. That is a decision outside the written rule, not a win under it. On the first engine seed alone the headline difference had been +1.86 ± 0.91, just beyond its margin of 1.82; the two further seeds on the generated suites gave +0.12 ± 0.80 on their own. The other candidates of that comparison, against the same holder: the main run alone at 196.6 M steps, headline 78.98 (level) and 71.10 on the organizer-style suite; the branch alone at 164.7 M steps, 78.34 (level, and worse by more than noise on `authored_hard_v1`, −5.71 ± 2.01) and 73.18; the average of the main run's last nine checkpoints, 79.02 on one seed (level). The same averaged weights with the default decoding (USE and weapon only) were level with the shipped setting on one seed (shipped minus default +0.82 ± 0.82 on the headline). Reports: `training/logs/final_pick_0618.txt`, `final_pick_0630_with_blend.txt`, `final_pick_three_seeds_shipped_main_clone.txt` and `final_pick_three_seeds_shipped_blend_main.txt`.
FINAL_CHOICE_SHORT: Chosen at 6:42 AM against the 5:37 AM agent: paired held-out difference +0.70 ± 0.74, level, so the rule alone kept the holder; Org. +6.64 ± 1.30, better by more than noise. The team lead shipped it because no suite is worse and the maps most like the organizers' own are clearly better: a decision outside the rule, not a win under it.
FINAL_LIMIT_WEIGHTS: **The shipped weights are an average that was never trained as one network.** They are the mean of two branches' weights: no gradient step was taken at these values, and the mean of two networks that play well need not play well. The two branches share their training up to 125.3 M steps of phase two and differ by the 71.3 M and 39.3 M steps after it; we did not test averages of networks further apart. Measured on the averaged weights, through the real agent: 3,115 held-out episodes with the shipped decoding (the tables above), the 80 development episodes, the nine-check ship gate and the manager's entropies in the next item. Not measured: any other weights than 0.5 and 0.5, a failure breakdown of its episodes (the one below is of the 1:38 AM agent), and the official maps and scorer
